name: Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Blue Sail Medical Co.,Ltd. operates as a medical device company in China and internationally. It operates through Health Protection Division, Cardiovascular and Cerebrovascular Business Unit, and Emergency Medical Services segments. The company offers cardiovascular and cerebrovascular products comprising drug-eluting stents and balloons, and transcatheter aortic valve replacement systems; and health protection gloves consisting of disposable nitrile, PVC, latex, TPE/CPE, and polyurethane gloves for use in medical examinations, food processing, industrial labor protection, daily protection, and other applications.
